updates.title: World Economic Outlook Update — July 2026
updates.summary: The IMF updated its April outlook, projecting 3.0% global growth in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027 while emphasizing the opposing effects of war-related energy shocks and technology investment.

updates.title: Global Economic Prospects — June 2026
updates.summary: The latest semiannual World Bank flagship outlook, with updated global and regional growth projections and downloadable data.

updates.title: World Health Statistics 2026
updates.summary: WHO's annual global overview of health indicators, mortality, disease burden and health-system progress.

updates.title: Democracy Report 2026
updates.summary: The 2026 V-Dem report and Dataset v16 provide updated cross-national evidence on democratization and autocratization.

updates.title: McKinsey Global Tech Agenda 2026
updates.summary: A survey of more than 600 technology and business leaders on agentic AI, data monetization and technology operating models.

updates.title: Global Risks Report 2026
updates.summary: The 21st edition assesses immediate 2026 risks, the short-to-medium term through 2028, and structural risks through 2036.
